text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me. That caught me completely 
off guard.\nDid you say... you want me to 
be your date?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"What you just said sounded so 
cool!\nAbout 'becoming rivals' and all..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Hehehe, sorry it's so out of 
nowhere.\nBut I—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Just now, I genuinely felt that I want to 
dance with you, Journey-senpai."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"We received awards in the same year, 
didn't we?\nBest Junior Umamusume and 
Queen Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"You made me realize I wasn't the only one 
dominating the Junior class.\nYour 'Asahi 
Hai FS'... that charge from dead last was 
insane."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"There are so many strong runners out 
there.\nIt fired me up... made me realize 
I had to hold my ground so I wouldn't fall 
behind."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"And when we actually clashed, you were 
incredible...!\nThat feeling of being 
watched from behind gave me total chills!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you think this kind of mutual 
respect... gets across to the audience, 
too?\nI really think it'd be super 'hot'!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "Hot... to the audience...?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "That's... what I believe!\nSo please!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Nnngh... Is that a no...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... My apologies. 
I was just lost in thought for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However... that might not be such a bad 
idea after all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...It never even crossed my mind. 
To offer oneself up willingly... Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: A "passionate" dance, was it...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Very well. 
I humbly accept your invitation.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...! All right! 
Thanks a bunch, senpai!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Vodka-san, you truly are a tempest...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! Those two teamed up!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh! Just you watch. 
We're taking Best Date for sure!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
——Let's do this. 
Our target is... Best Date.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, they're amazing too! Are they pros?! 
Is this year's Droite gonna be insane, or 
what...?!

And so, the days flew by until the eve of 
the main event. 
Many pairs were sweating it out in the 
dance studios, and their skills were—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... How wondrous. 
Do these warriors know no limits?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That initial quiet seems like a lie now! 
Every pair is dead serious! 
Love it, love it♪ This is gonna be one 
lively banquet!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Still, what's our move? We've got a lot 
more tough rivals now. 
If we don't step up our game, they'll 
snatch the prize right out from under us.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Should we throw in some even harder 
acrobatics? 
We've come this far, so I'm down for 
whatever madness you've got!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
No, I have no intention of resorting to 
petty parlor tricks. 
What we need is... "destruction".

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Shatter the illusions of the past! 
And upon the scorched earth, we shall 
"create" a brand-new dance!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Wait, does that mean... we're switching 
dances 
right here and now?!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: My... Look at those two...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Like this?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No, with more ferocity! 
Dance like you're out to conquer the 
world! One more time, one, two, three—!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! What are you guys doing? 
That's completely different from what you 
were doing before...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. From this moment forth, our dance 
shall undergo a metamorphosis.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh... Wait, what... Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what?! Those two are changing their 
dance?! 
Doing that now is total madness! What are 
they thinking~?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Think it's impossible, do you? 
That's what makes it romantic—the sheer 
scale of the dream!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah—!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! Amazing... 
They're still aiming even higher...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Gim-senpai—!
